ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( ISCHANGED(TravelType__c),
OR( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(TravelType__c), "OCONUS (Foreign or Alaska)"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(TravelType__c), "CONUS (Contiguous 48 States)"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(TravelType__c), "Intra-state Same Day"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(TravelType__c), "Intra-state Overnight Travel") ),
NOT( OR( AND( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(TravelType__c), "Intra-state Same Day"), ISPICKVAL(TravelType__c, "Intra-state Overnight Travel") ), AND( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(TravelType__c), "Intra-state Overnight Travel"), ISPICKVAL(TravelType__c, "Intra-state Same Day") ) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Travel Type can only be changed between "Intra-state Same Day" and "Intra-state Overnight Travel". Changes to or from CONUS and OCONUS values are not permitted.
